a.text: The name Ghaziuddinnagar was shortened to Ghaziabad with the opening of the Railways.

b.text: The Scinde, Punjab & Delhi Railway through Ghaziabad was opened.

a.text: The Amritsar-Saharanpur-Ghaziabad line of the Sind, Punjab and Delhi Railway was completed.

b.text: Ghaziabad became the junction of the East Indian Railway and Sind, Punjab and Delhi Railway.

a.text: The Mohan Meakin breweries were set up.

b.text: Mohan Nagar Industrial Estate was set up.

a.text: International Tobacco Co. was set up.
